problems: The decision options list uses names that are not in the UI: "**Retry**", "**Narrow**", "**Split**", "**Re-plan**", "**Instruct**", "**Hold**". Which ones a card offers depends on its kind.

"Depending on your settings and the issue, Studio may resolve a routine problem or ask you." This is too vague. Since 0.4.4, in **Auto** and **Elevated only** the desk settles ordinary asks on the desk seat's model (main.cjs `deskResolvesOn` returns true for auto/elevated). It labels the answer "Mefi decided" with its reason, keeps your stop and the card's budgets, and never learns the answer as your preference. Activating a map changes the permission mode and New work only when its confirm list shows them moving (Unreleased: "Permission modes keep their meaning"). The worker limit is at most 3 (docs/brain-maps.md Gates).

"**Map › Duplicate this map**", "**Draft with AI**", "**Make this live**" and "**Reset to the shipped pipeline**" are correct. The page leaves out the Map menu's other items: New empty map, Discard unsaved changes and Delete this map (template #brains-more-menu).

problems: The network table is missing features coming in 0.4.5 that send data out. **Share between my PCs** uses one private GitHub repository `<you>/mefi-studio-vault`, with every file sealed with AES-256-GCM under a key only your paired PCs hold. Items are checked going out and coming in, and keys are sent only after a typed confirmation. **Share with friends** writes a scrubbed, previewed `.mefishare` file. **Keep this PC up to date** asks GitHub once a minute, and the Your PCs check runs 45 s after launch and then every 15 min. **Set up this PC** signs you in to GitHub in the browser, and Studio never sees the token. **Friends › Rooms** chat goes through the rooms hub, and every room says "Void Engine moderators can read every room." **Cowork claims** send the paths of files a builder will edit to the linked room. **Playground** shares companion cards only at the level you allow and lists them under What was sent.

"Discord provides your account identity and membership details for the community server." This is vague. Linking reads your Discord id, username and display name, plus your role ids and join date in the Void Engine server, using scopes identify and guilds.members.read. It reads them when you link, about weekly after that, and when you press Check now. The refresh token is encrypted in community-auth.json, and Unlink revokes it (SECURITY.md; template #community-privacy).

"Discord linking and shared rooms are still rolling out." Still true: the build ships with no link app ID and no hub address (scripts/community.cjs `CLIENT_ID = ""`, scripts/hub-client.cjs `HUB_URL = ""`). The page should add that 0.4.5 lets you enter both under Settings › General › Community › Connection details (Unreleased: "Discord linking and Rooms without environment variables").

"The room service receives your shared media link and Discord name." Add that Studio sends your Discord access token to the hub once per 15-minute session, the hub checks it with Discord and drops it, and listen-together and now-playing data live in memory only (SECURITY.md; bot docs/privacy.md).
"Do not post `auth.json`, `community-auth.json`, `settings.json` or your `data/` folder." Add session.json, your vault pairing code, and any `.mefishare` you have not reviewed.

Coming in 0.4.5: a friend's `.mefishare` can carry only how agents behave and learn. It can never change your permissions.

Keep-control section: name all four permission modes and the elevated categories that stay with you by default (Granting reach, Irreversible changes, Closing your work, Work agents propose, A pricier model, Real-world to-dos). Link to the proposed permissions page.

neededContent: Q: Is everything free? Are there paid cosmetics? Answer: every theme and node style has been free since 0.4.4, and Discord is optional. Community credits, advertising and cosmetics are ideas only and are not built.
Q: What is Vibe and what is Build? Answer: Vibe is the default calm front door; Build is the full studio. Switch at the top or in Settings › General › Studio mode.

Q: Can I share my setup with a friend? Answer: coming in 0.4.5, a `.mefishare` file holds one brain, recipe, team setup, set of model results, memory note or preferences, scrubbed and previewed. A friend's file is reviewed before use and can't change your permissions.

outline: Where Friends lives: the companion's **Friends** bubble. In 0.4.4 it holds Your PCs and the listening-room link; in 0.4.5 it holds Playground, Rooms and Your PCs, and badges invites and requests.

What you need first (rolling-out): a linked Discord account in the Void Engine server plus a running rooms hub. The release ships with no hub address or link app ID. Coming in 0.4.5: enter both once per PC in Settings › General › Community › Connection details; 'Save' says whether the hub answered.

Rooms (coming 0.4.5, rolling-out): browse your rooms and listed ones; **Ask to join** with a note; accept or decline invites; **Make a room** (hangout or cowork; 'Anyone can ask to join' or 'Invite only'; listed or not); owners let people in, invite by name, lock, close. Room chat is plain text with @names, and links are never clickable. Leave, Close and Delete ask twice. Every room says 'Void Engine moderators can read every room.'

Listen together and Share what I'm playing (in the code since 0.4.0, rolling-out): pick a room in Music & video › Links and play a link for it; others choose **Listen along**. Playground (coming 0.4.5): friends' companions in the same room meet for short scripted playdates, and **Practice with Pip** works on this PC alone. Nothing about you is shared until you allow it (everyone / a room / a friend, this session or always), and What was sent lists every card that left.

Cowork rooms for agents (coming 0.4.5, rolling-out): open a room and choose **Use this room for this project's agents**. Builders on every PC claim the files they will edit, and other PCs wait on those files.
Privacy in one paragraph: what the hub and bot keep (in memory only for listening; no message text stored by the bot), `/forget-me`, and a link to the privacy page.

Ideas, not features: sharing mixes and showing the most-played ones for people who turn on music sharing; credits for playing or looking at projects; spending credits to promote a project; cosmetics for credits. Mark all as 'idea' and link to the roadmap and the feature-request paths.

newPages.title: Your PCs: sync and sharing
newPages.summary: Keep a project in step across your PCs and move chosen settings safely between them or to a friend
outline: Where: companion › Friends › Your PCs. Opening it only looks.

Sync this PC (released 0.4.4): compares this PC with the project's default branch on GitHub and lists uncommitted files, unpushed commits, stashes, worktrees and local-only branches; pulls and pushes without force. Coming in 0.4.5: it pushes only after the project's `npm run check` passes.

Coming in 0.4.5: **Put my commits on top of GitHub's** (rebase when both sides moved; a conflict changes nothing); the Friends badge for work only this PC holds (checked 45 s after launch, then every 15 min); closing asks first; **Keep this PC up to date** (on by default, once a minute, fast-forward only when safe).

Set up this PC (coming 0.4.5): a checklist for Git, GitHub CLI, Node.js, GitHub sign-in (in the browser; Studio never sees the token), the project's remote, packages, and a drive that can hold worktrees (not exFAT/FAT). Each gap has a button that opens a visible setup window. **Get a project from GitHub** clones one of your repositories.

Share between my PCs (coming 0.4.5): one private repo `<you>/mefi-studio-vault`, AES-256-GCM sealed, with a pairing code typed on each other PC. Shelves: model results, learned decisions, team setups, brains, Playbook recipes, Claude Code memory notes, preferences, open tasks and ideas. Items are checked both ways, received items never overwrite yours, and keys need the exact typed confirmation.
Share with friends (coming 0.4.5): save one item as a scrubbed, previewed `.mefishare`; opening a friend's file runs the same review; a friend's file can't change your permissions.
From a terminal: `npm run sync` (and `--rebase`) for people who run from source.
What never moves: conversations, and saved logins unless you choose Keys and setup.

notes:
Method: every claim was checked against origin/main, which equals HEAD 6c1c940. The task said the working tree was clean, but it is not. It has uncommitted peer-session edits to renderer/nav.js, rooms.js, music.js, idle.js, companion-hub.js, companion-ui.js, agent-brain.js, studio-ui.js, tasks.js, styles.css and the booklet, plus an untracked tests/type_into_menu.test.mjs. None of that is on origin, so it was ignored. I made no writes.

How releases were split:
- **Released:** `git show v0.4.4:` was the baseline.
- **Coming in 0.4.5:** these modules are on main but absent from v0.4.4, so their features are coming-0.4.5: renderer/setup-helper.js, config-dialog.js, rooms.js, pc-vault.js, companion-friends.js, vibe-flow.js, motion.js, plus scripts/loop-status.cjs, habits.cjs and cli-accounts.cjs.
- **Present in v0.4.4:** trace.js, together.js and pc-sync.js (Sync this PC only).
- **Rolling out:** scripts/hub-client.cjs has `HUB_URL = ""` and scripts/community.cjs has `CLIENT_ID = ""` on main. So Rooms, Listen together, Share what I'm playing, Discord linking, Playground with friends and cowork claims all need 0.4.5's Settings › General › Community › Connection details plus a running hub (docs/friends-setup.md).

Labels confirmed as correct (keep them):
- Agents sections: Overview, Setup (Team & models / Providers / Routing & fallback / Run behavior), Live (Command, Pipelines, Sessions, Activity, Trace, Overhead), Workflows (Brain maps, Playbook, Project map, Context), Models (Catalog, Performance), Usage (Recorded calls, Provider accounts). Same in v0.4.4.
- Visible Settings categories: General, Appearance, Audio, System. agents.js removes Connections, Models and Automation.
- Keys: H, D, T, P, I, B, J, E, O, A, 1, 2, 3, 4, U, ?, /, R, G, Ctrl K, Ctrl ,. Coming in 0.4.5: Ctrl Shift , (Configuration). Trace has no key.

Ideas the owner raised that have no code in the app or the Void Engine Bot repo (label them "idea" only):
- credits for playing or looking at others' projects
- spending credits to advertise your own
- cosmetics or styles for credits
- sharing mixes and showing the most-played ones under a "share music taste" setting

Things to keep in mind for those ideas:
- The closest real features are the opt-in Share what I'm playing / `/nowplaying` and Listen together (rolling out), Playground (0.4.5) and `.mefishare` (0.4.5).
- The bot README commits to "never tracks or rewards invites or referrals, and never rewards raw message counts", and XP is capped with no leaderboard. A credits design should respect that.
